parts.note_add: Two-speed permanent-magnet motor with separate LO and HI brushes, common brush on L (IG feed), switched on the ground side by the combination switch; internal cam park (auto-stop) switch on LB grounds the circuit away from park and joins LB to L at park (S-001 p18, S-045 15:4). 1980 factory test: low 43-60 rpm, high 62-95 rpm, under 4 A no load (other-car; confirm).
Holds the three brushes (common, LO, HI); worn brushes are the factory's first cause of abnormal wiper noise (S-002 15-43).
Gear box carries the worm gear and the cam-operated park switch (terminal LB) that gives auto-stop (S-001 p18).

Printable replacement linkage bushings and motor mounts exist (cad rows rx7-sa22c-wiper-refresh-kit-printables-grantd, fb-wiper-grommet-printables-lovc). Factory: insufficient grease in the link joints causes wiper noise (S-002 15-43).
Park the blades at the upper (park) position before removing the arms (S-045 15:3).
Aftermarket fitment lists 17 in blades for 1982, driver and passenger (confirm by measuring the fitted blade).
